sources.title: Meet MedPsy: a private medical AI model small enough for yo…
sources.snippet: A private medical AI model built to run on your device MedPsy is a family of small medical language models developed by Tether Data's AI Research group as part of the QVAC platform, Tether's open-source, local-AI ecosystem. It answers everyday medical questions and walks through clinical reasoning in clear, plain text.
